title: Customer Service Environment
dek: Turncraft, a customer-service environment I built in Python, gives an agent nine tools that change order records, and rewards it for what the records end up saying, not for what the agent said. This page rebuilds that scoring in your browser and runs scripted trajectories through it.
summary: Rewards a support agent for what its tools changed, not what it said. Two refunds of the same amount: the duplicate capture resolves the case, the first one scores below zero.
